new_description: Hull plate of uridium alloy, a staple of Cardassian shipbuilding. Plain, in the ochre of the Union's fleets, and sound enough to bring a ship home. Gives almost no protection against fire; it is there to soak up damage. Weighs less than the Refinery Ceramic Plate and more than the Orbital Yard Laminate, and the most fragile of them.
A laminate rolled out in bulk at the orbital assembly yards above Cardassia Prime. There is always more of it. Some protection against explosions. The lightest Cardassian ship plate of its size.

Ceramic fired from the by-products of uridite ore, refined by the Union at stations like Terok Nor. The Union can turn it out in vast numbers. Some protection against kinetic rounds and explosions. Weighs less than the Gul Composite Plate and more than the Galor Hull Plate.

Uridium alloy bonded in layers with other metals. The Union cannot afford to waste ships, so the plate is made to keep them alive. Good protection against explosions, some protection against kinetic rounds. Weighs less than the Obsidian Lattice Plate and more than the Refinery Ceramic Plate.

Crystal lattice plating, dark as obsidian, developed in the Obsidian Order's own laboratories. Its makers will not say how it works, only that it does. Good protection against explosions, some protection against kinetic rounds. Weighs less than the Burn-Off Plate and more than the Gul Composite Plate, and among the toughest. It also turns aside armour-piercing rounds well.

Ablative plate that burns away in layers, so the first hits fall on plating and not on the crew. The Union has plenty of plate and fewer ships than it needs. Some protection against kinetic rounds, beams, energy fire and explosions. The heaviest Cardassian ship plate of its size, and the toughest of them. It also turns aside armour-piercing rounds well.

Ablative plating for the ring and pylons of a Nor-style station, whose pylons are packed with ore processing plant. Replaced after every siege. Strong protection against kinetic rounds, beams, energy fire and explosions, good protection against plasma. The heaviest Cardassian orbital plate of its size, and the toughest of them. It also turns aside armour-piercing rounds well.

Living plate regrown from reclaimed waste. A people short of resources learn to waste nothing, armour included. Strong protection against every kind of fire. The lightest Cardassian orbital plate of its size.

Crystal grown through a living scaffold from reclaimed material, which seals cracks as they open. Strong protection against every kind of fire. Weighs less than the Orbital Ring Plate and more than the Reclamation Bioplate, and among the toughest. It also turns aside armour-piercing rounds well.

Polarised plating for a station's habitat ring, tuned to bleed off energy fire and built to hold through a long siege. Some protection against kinetic rounds and explosions. Weighs less than the Station Ablative Plating and more than the Reclaimed Crystal Plate, and the most fragile of them.
